tactical_thesis: Rebuild candidate 2 around earlier artillery clearance, upper-central damage and controlled lower-outer healing. Deploy Steward at2071 rather than2444, after Melantha has carried a locked projectile away from the medical formation. Return Melantha beside Fang rather than Friston. Keep Midnight on his original lane and preserve his eastern-roadblock clearance. Reserve Spot's first healing period for the second lower barrage, then keep him attacking until the final lower-outer officer is captured.
